response.text:
Journal 1677 has Dr 5100 of 13,971.23 against Cr 2000 of 13,980.23. The finding says the credit to AP equals the invoice amount, so the debit side is the part that is wrong. The fix is a single debit of 9.00 to 5100, which restores the original debit to the 13,980.23 invoice amount.

The correction goes in period 11, the earliest open period, because period 5 is closed. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 1677 debits 5100 for 13,971.23 but credits AP Control 2000 for 13,980.23, which equals the invoice amount. The debit side is short by 9.00. A one-sided debit of 9.00 to 5100 brings the group to Dr 13,980.23 and Cr 13,980.23 and balances it. Period 5 is closed, so the line posts to open period 11. No invoice status is changed.
